spec.description: Factory floor kiosk. ISA-101 compliant. Zero interaction, zero scrolling. 1920x1080.

spec.title: Fleet Availability
spec.description: Percentage of selected machines whose latest telemetry record in the selected time range is RUN.

spec.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (eqp_id) eqp_id, state
  FROM public.ldi_data
  WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
    AND eqp_id IN (${eqp_id:sqlstring}) AND layer_name IN (${layer_name:sqlstring}) AND log_id IN (${log_id:sqlstring})
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
  ORDER BY eqp_id, time DESC
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = true) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS value
FROM latest

WITH latest_data AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (eqp_id) 
    eqp_id AS "Machine", process AS "Process", CASE WHEN state THEN 'RUN' ELSE 'DOWN' END AS "State",
    mo AS "MO", fpn AS "FPN", layer_name AS "Layer",
    CASE WHEN board_no IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE board_no::TEXT || '/' || total_board::TEXT END AS "Board",
    ROUND(temperature::NUMERIC, 1) AS "Temp", ROUND(humidity::NUMERIC, 1) AS "RH",
    "time" AS "Updated", factory AS "Factory", log_id AS "Log ID", 'ldi_data' AS "Source"
  FROM public.ldi_data
  WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND layer_name IN (${layer_name:sqlstring}) AND log_id IN (${log_id:sqlstring}) AND eqp_id IN (${eqp_id:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter("time")
  ORDER BY eqp_id, "time" DESC
),
latest_alarm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (equipmentid) equipmentid AS eqp_id, logdate
  FROM public.ldi_alarm_log
  WHERE $__timeFilter(logdate)
  ORDER BY equipmentid, logdate DESC
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(d."Machine", a.eqp_id) AS "Machine",
  d."Process", d."State", d."MO", d."FPN", d."Layer", d."Board", d."Temp", d."RH",
  COALESCE(d."Updated", a.logdate) AS "Updated",
  d."Factory", d."Log ID",
  CASE WHEN d."Machine" IS NULL THEN 'alarm_only' ELSE d."Source" END AS "Source"
FROM latest_data d
FULL OUTER JOIN latest_alarm a ON d."Machine" = a.eqp_id
ORDER BY "Updated" DESC

spec.title: Alarm Summary
spec.description: Alarm summary for the selected factory and machines. Green means zero events; category colors appear when a count is greater than zero. UNMAPPED identifies error codes that are missing from the alarm master.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*)::NUMERIC AS "Total",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE $__timeFilter(a.logdate) AND m.alarm_type = 'A')::NUMERIC AS "A",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE $__timeFilter(a.logdate) AND m.alarm_type = 'W')::NUMERIC AS "W",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE $__timeFilter(a.logdate) AND m.alarm_type = 'E')::NUMERIC AS "E",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE $__timeFilter(a.logdate) AND m.alarm_code IS NULL)::NUMERIC AS "UNMAPPED"
FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a
LEFT JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m
  ON a.errorcode::TEXT = m.alarm_id::TEXT
WHERE $__timeFilter(a.logdate) AND a.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND a.equipmentid IN (${eqp_id:sqlstring})

spec.title: Env. Compliance
spec.description: Environmental Compliance: percentage of machines within safe temperature AND humidity.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  ROUND(
    COUNT(DISTINCT eqp_id) FILTER (
      WHERE
        temperature BETWEEN 20
        AND 24
        AND humidity BETWEEN 50
        AND 60
    ) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT eqp_id), 0),
    0
  ) AS value
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      DISTINCT ON (eqp_id) eqp_id,
      temperature,
      humidity,
      "time",
      factory,
      mo,
      layer_name,
      log_id
    FROM
      public.ldi_data
    WHERE
      $__timeFilter("time")
    ORDER BY
      eqp_id,
      "time" DESC
  ) d
WHERE
  factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
  AND eqp_id IN (${eqp_id:sqlstring})
  AND layer_name IN (${layer_name:sqlstring})
  AND log_id IN (${log_id:sqlstring})
  AND temperature IS NOT NULL
  AND humidity IS NOT NULL

spec.title: state Timeline
spec.description: Machine Run State: per-machine green/red timeline showing RUNNING vs STOPPED.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  time,
  eqp_id AS metric,
  CASE
    WHEN state = true THEN 1
    ELSE 0 
  END AS value
FROM
  public.ldi_data
WHERE
  factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
  AND eqp_id IN (${eqp_id:sqlstring})
  AND layer_name IN (${layer_name:sqlstring})
  AND log_id IN (${log_id:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY
  time ASC

spec.title: ldi_data — Latest Production
spec.description: Live Production: current MO, part, layer, and board progress per machine.

spec.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (eqp_id) eqp_id AS "Machine", mo AS "Job (MO)", fpn AS "Part (FPN)", layer_name AS "Layer", (board_no::TEXT || '/' || total_board::TEXT) AS "Progress" FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND eqp_id IN (${eqp_id:sqlstring}) AND layer_name IN (${layer_name:sqlstring}) AND log_id IN (${log_id:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY eqp_id, time DESC LIMIT 50

spec.title: ldi_alarm_log + ldi_alarm_ms_code — All Records
spec.description: All matching ldi_alarm_log rows for the selected factory and machines. Every source column is shown, plus every joined master-code column and mapping status. Pagination is visual only; the SQL query has no row limit.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  a.logid,
  a.logdate,
  a.errorcode,
  a.errortime,
  a.equipmentid,
  a.factory,
  a.process,
  COALESCE(m.alarm_id, 'UNMAPPED') AS alarm_id,
  COALESCE(m.alarm_type, 'UNMAPPED') AS alarm_type,
  COALESCE(m.alarm_code, a.errorcode::TEXT) AS alarm_code,
  COALESCE(m.alarm_msg, a.errorcode::TEXT) AS alarm_msg,
  CASE
    WHEN m.alarm_code IS NULL THEN 'No master record for this errorcode'
    ELSE COALESCE(m.alarm_detail, 'No detail provided in master')
  END AS alarm_detail,
  CASE WHEN m.alarm_code IS NULL THEN 'UNMAPPED' ELSE 'MAPPED' END AS mapping_status
FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a
LEFT JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m
  ON a.errorcode::TEXT = m.alarm_id::TEXT
WHERE $__timeFilter(a.logdate) AND a.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND a.equipmentid IN (${eqp_id:sqlstring})
ORDER BY a.logdate DESC

spec.title: Running Machines
spec.description: Count of selected machines whose latest telemetry record in the selected time range is RUN.

spec.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (eqp_id) eqp_id, state
  FROM public.ldi_data
  WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
    AND eqp_id IN (${eqp_id:sqlstring}) AND layer_name IN (${layer_name:sqlstring}) AND log_id IN (${log_id:sqlstring})
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
  ORDER BY eqp_id, time DESC
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = true)::NUMERIC AS value
FROM latest
